reasons.claim: Ma'mar relays from al-Zuhri, who names Urwa, who relays from Aisha, so the single route runs Ibn Rafi', Abd al-Razzaq, Ma'mar, al-Zuhri, Urwa, Aisha as both readers wrote.
reasons.quote: قال قال الزهري وأخبرني عروة، عن عائشة

reasons.claim: Aisha's own words open the saying, so she is the last link.
reasons.quote: عن عائشة، أنها قالت أول ما بدئ به

reasons.claim: The mention of Yunus only compares this version with his, a remark under ruling 6.
reasons.quote: وساق الحديث بمثل حديث يونس

reviews.question: The report opens «وقال الحلبي له» with no transmitter before al-Halabi and the one asked only as the pronoun «له», and the packet gives no previous report to inherit from: is the unnamed answerer a link (implicit transmission, unruled), and does the report inherit its source from an earlier report?

reasons.claim: The asker is named but the one asked and answering is only a pronoun.
reasons.quote: وَقَالَ اَلْحَلَبِيُّ لَهُ

reasons.claim: The answer has no named speaker in the text.
reasons.quote: قَالَ «أَجْمِلْهُمْ.

reasons.claim: Reader B itself notes that no previous report is supplied, so the source cannot be inherited from the packet.
reasons.quote: no previous report is supplied in the context, so the Imam is not written

reviews.uncertainty_note: A single-link chain ending at an asker with an unnamed answerer turns on an unruled question.

reasons.claim: Abd al-Malik relays from his father and his grandfather, named only by relation, then Uqayl.
reasons.quote: قال حدثني أبي، عن جدي، قال حدثني عقيل بن خالد

reasons.claim: Ibn Shihab heard Urwa, who quotes Aisha, so Aisha is the last link.
reasons.quote: قال ابن شهاب سمعت عروة بن الزبير، يقول قالت عائشة

reasons.claim: Yunus and Ma'mar are named only to compare versions, a remark under ruling 6.
reasons.quote: واقتص الحديث بمثل حديث يونس ومعمر

variant_verdicts.quote: واقتص الحديث بمثل حديث يونس ومعمر
واقتص الحديث بمثل حديث يونس ومعمر

reasons.claim: Hanzala asks Rafi' and Rafi' answers with the saying, so the asker is a link and Rafi' is the last link (rulings 2 and 3).
reasons.quote: قال سألت رافع بن خديج عن كراء الأرض، فقال

reasons.claim: The chain runs Amr b. Ali, Yahya, Malik, Rabi'a, Hanzala as written.
reasons.quote: قال حدثنا مالك، عن ربيعة، عن حنظلة بن قيس

reasons.claim: The note on Sufyan al-Thawri is the form «رواه X عن Y ولم يرفعه» that ruling 6 already makes a variant remark, so the readers' needs_ruling flag is settled.
reasons.quote: رواه سفيان الثوري رضى الله عنه عن ربيعة ولم يرفعه

variant_verdicts.quote: رواه سفيان الثوري رضى الله عنه عن ربيعة ولم يرفعه
رواه سفيان الثوري رضى الله عنه عن ربيعة ولم يرفعه

reasons.claim: Nafi' was present and Rafi' spoke in the encounter, so under ruling 9 Rafi' follows Nafi' as a link.
reasons.quote: وأنا معه فحدثه رافع عن بعض عمومته

reasons.claim: Rafi' relays from an unnamed uncle, an unnamed link before the Prophet.
reasons.quote: عن بعض عمومته أن رسول الله

reasons.claim: Ibn Umar is the subject of the scene and only hears, so he is not a link (ruling 4).
reasons.quote: فترك عبد الله بعد

reasons.claim: After «ح» the two heads meet at Sa'id b. Abi Ayyub, so the first route must carry the shared tail, not stop at Abd Allah b. Yazid.
reasons.quote: - المعنى - حدثني سعيد بن أبي أيوب

reasons.claim: Ja'far's version adds al-Layth beside Sa'id, a co-transmitter on the second route only.
reasons.quote: وزاد، جعفر والليث حدثني يزيد بن أبي حبيب

reasons.claim: Ubayd tells of an encounter in which Abu Basra speaks the saying, so under ruling 9 Abu Basra is the last link after Ubayd.
reasons.quote: قال أبو بصرة أترغب عن سنة رسول الله

reasons.claim: The encounter is Ubayd's own account with Abu Basra.
reasons.quote: قال كنت مع أبي بصرة الغفاري

notes: «- المعنى -» joins both heads at Sa'id; the tail from Yazid b. Abi Habib is written once for both routes
«وزاد، جعفر والليث» adds al-Layth beside Sa'id in Ja'far's route
Abu Basra speaks the saying inside Ubayd's encounter (ruling 9)
«- قال جعفر ابن جبر -» is a gloss, left out

reviews.uncertainty_note: Placing al-Layth only on Ja'far's route rests on reading «وزاد، جعفر والليث» as Ja'far adding al-Layth, which is the clearer but not the only reading.

reasons.claim: Three co-transmitters share the chain written once after them.
reasons.quote: حدثنا معتمر بن سليمان، ويزيد بن هارون، وهشيم، عن سليمان التيمي، عن أمية

reasons.claim: The text itself says only Mu'tamir names Umayya, so the routes of Yazid and Hushaym run from Sulayman to Abu Mijlaz without Umayya.
reasons.quote: قال ابن عيسى لم يذكر أمية أحد إلا معتمر

reasons.claim: Both readers kept Umayya in all three routes, against that statement.
reasons.quote: the reading keeps the text's single chain and leaves the remark for review

notes: «لم يذكر أمية أحد إلا معتمر»: Umayya stands only in Mu'tamir's route; Yazid and Hushaym go from Sulayman al-Taymi to Abu Mijlaz

reviews.uncertainty_note: The rulings do not say outright whether the compiler's own statement on who names a link reshapes the written routes, though the text states it plainly.

reasons.claim: The chain runs al-Ansari, Ma'n, Malik, Zayd, Abd al-Hamid, Muslim b. Yasar, Umar as written.
reasons.quote: عن عبد الحميد بن عبد الرحمن بن زيد بن الخطاب، عن مسلم بن يسار الجهني، أن عمر بن الخطاب

reasons.claim: Umar quotes hearing the Prophet, so he is the last link.
reasons.quote: قال عمر بن الخطاب سمعت رسول الله

reasons.claim: The unknown man is the compiler's remark on another version, not a route of this saying.
reasons.quote: وقد ذكر بعضهم في هذا الإسناد بين مسلم بن يسار وبين عمر رجلا مجهولا

variant_verdicts.quote: وقد ذكر بعضهم في هذا الإسناد بين مسلم بن يسار وبين عمر رجلا مجهولا

reviews.question: After Salim the text has «أنحدثه» with no named subject: someone unnamed told Salim of a scene in which Umar speaks; whether this implicit transmitter is an unnamed link and Umar (who speaks in the scene, ruling 9) the last link, or the chain stops at Salim, turns on the unruled question of implicit transmission.

reasons.claim: The transmitter after Salim is only implied by a verb with no named subject.
reasons.quote: عن سالم، أنحدثه قال قبل عمر بن الخطاب الحجر ثم قال

reasons.claim: Umar speaks inside the scene and relays what he saw of the Prophet, so under ruling 9 he would be a link, which both readers leave out.
reasons.quote: ولولا أني رأيت رسول الله

reasons.claim: The heads are correct: Harmala's route branches to Yunus and Amr, Harun's to Amr, and they share Ibn Shihab and Salim.
reasons.quote: أخبرني يونس، وعمرو، ح وحدثني هارون بن سعيد الأيلي

reasons.claim: Zayd b. Aslam's route is given only «بمثلها», a remark about another version under ruling 6.
reasons.quote: قال عمرو وحدثني بمثلها زيد بن أسلم عن أبيه أسلم

variant_verdicts.quote: قال عمرو وحدثني بمثلها زيد بن أسلم عن أبيه أسلم
قال عمرو وحدثني بمثلها زيد بن أسلم عن أبيه أسلم

reviews.uncertainty_note: The end of the chain depends on an implicit, unnamed transmitter that the rulings do not settle.

reasons.claim: Seven shaykhs together relay from Ali b. Ibrahim, one level of co-transmitters.
reasons.quote: قالُوا: حَدَّثَنا عَلِىُّ بْنُ إِبراهِيمَ بْنِ هاشِمٍ

reasons.claim: Sufyan tells of an encounter in which al-Ma'mun speaks and relays the whole account, so under ruling 9 al-Ma'mun is the last link after Sufyan; the readers stopped at Sufyan.
reasons.quote: كُنْتُ يَوْماً عَلَى رَأْسِ الْمَأمُونِ، فَقالَ: أَتَدْرُونَ مَنْ عَلَّمَني التَّشَيُّعَ؟

reasons.claim: The rest of the story is al-Ma'mun's own first-person narrative, so those inside it are not links of this chain.
reasons.quote: وَلَقَدْ حَجَجْتُ مَعَهُ سِنَةً

reasons.claim: The readers asked for a ruling on exactly this narrated-encounter case, which ruling 9 now settles.
reasons.quote: so whether this is a source or only the scene is for ruling

levels.surface: الحُسَيْنُ بْنُ إِبْراهيمَ بْنِ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ هِشامِ المُكَتَّبُ
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ زِيادِ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ الْهَمَذانيُّ
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَلِىِّ بْنِ إِبراهِيمَ بْنِ هاشِمٍ

notes: seven co-transmitters joined by «؛» and «و» with «قالوا» form one level
Sufyan narrates an encounter in which al-Ma'mun speaks and tells the whole story: al-Ma'mun is the last link (ruling 9)
those who speak inside al-Ma'mun's own account are not added

reviews.uncertainty_note: Ruling 9 makes al-Ma'mun the last link; whether anyone speaking inside his account should be followed further is less clear, and this reading stops at him.
